svg.title: Atelier Flow critical component sets
svg.desc: Visual source sheet for ten Couture component sets, their variants, states, auto layout contracts, and accessibility targets.

g.text: Couture source sheet · Auto Layout contracts · native variants · minimum target 44 × 44
Auto Layout H · gap 8 · padding 16/24 · min-height 52 · radius 2 · Type × State
VARIANTS 15 / LABEL TEXT PROPERTY / OPTIONAL ICON SLOT / LIVE LOADING STATUS
Auto Layout V · gap 12 · width 300 · Media=Primary/Secondary × Swatch=Oat/Ink
MEDIA CROSSFADE ONLY ON HOVER-CAPABLE POINTERS / SWATCH ANNOUNCES COLOR / COPY MAY WRAP
Auto Layout H · center · min 52 × 52 · Kind=Size/Color × State=Default/Selected/Disabled
Selected uses shape plus contrast, unavailable uses strike plus label, never color alone.
Focus adds a 2px external ring without changing dimensions.
Auto Layout V · width 420 · header min-height 56 · State=Collapsed/Expanded/Focus

text.tspan: Dry clean or brush between wears.

g.text: ARIA-EXPANDED / BUTTON OWNS PANEL / CONTENT REMAINS IN DOCUMENT FLOW
Auto Layout H · width 320 · min-height 76 · State=Hidden/Visible/Loading/Success
Appears after primary buy buttons leave viewport; never covers cookie or accessibility UI.
Safe-area inset included on mobile. Success announces once, then returns to Visible.
Auto Layout H · gap 16 · image 92 × 116 · stepper 132 × 44 · State=Default/Updating/Error
Only one piece remains. Quantity restored to 1.
STEPPER BUTTONS 44 / REMOVE 44 / UPDATE REGION POLITE / ERROR ADJACENT TO ITEM
Fixed viewport · backdrop blur 12 · panel width 520/390 · State=Open/Empty/Error
DIALOG / FOCUS TRAP / ESC CLOSE / RETURN FOCUS / INTERNAL SCROLL / STICKY FOOTER
Fixed target 44 × 44 · State=Idle/Hover/Focus/Active · visual dot 16 · pulse reduced-motion aware
EDGE FLIP IS LAYOUT LOGIC, NOT A VISUAL VARIANT / LABEL REMAINS AVAILABLE TO ASSISTIVE TECH
Auto Layout H · width 420 · min-height 96 · Type=Product/Article/Suggestion × State=Default/Active
OPTION ROLE / ARROW KEY ACTIVE STATE / MATCHED VARIANT AND PRICE / GROUP LABELS ANNOUNCED
Auto Layout V · gap 8 · width 320 · field min-height 52 · State=Default/Focus/Error/Disabled
Label, value, placeholder, hint and error message remain editable.
Visible label, described-by hint/error, no placeholder-only fields, focus ring outside bounds.
Success is conveyed in copy and icon; Error preserves entered value.
TOTAL: 10 COMPONENT SETS / 52 CORE VARIANTS / COUTURE TOKENS / AUTO LAYOUT CONTRACTS
